datasets.name: ds_velocity_recent
queryLines: SELECT * FROM rubjit_jira.gold.fct_sprint_velocity WHERE state = 'closed' AND complete_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY complete_date DESC LIMIT 12

datasets.name: ds_issue_open
queryLines: SELECT * FROM rubjit_jira.gold.fct_issue WHERE NOT is_resolved

datasets.name: ds_issue_resolved_180
queryLines: SELECT * FROM rubjit_jira.gold.fct_issue WHERE is_resolved AND resolved_at >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 180 DAYS

fields.name: value
fields.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN complete_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN points_completed END)

fields.name: cycle_bucket
fields.expression: CASE WHEN cycle_time_days < 1 THEN '< 1d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 3 THEN '1-3d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 7 THEN '3-7d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 14 THEN '7-14d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 30 THEN '14-30d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 60 THEN '30-60d' WHEN cycle_time_days < 90 THEN '60-90d' ELSE '90d+' END
